title: Sharing a Flat Again
sentences: At thirty-four I moved back into a shared flat.
I had lived alone for six years and had assumed I preferred it that way.
Rents in the city had risen faster than my salary for several years.
My two flatmates are both younger than me and considerably tidier as well.
We agreed on a cleaning rota in the first week.
It works, mostly because one of them reminds the rest of us about it.
The evenings are noisier than I had grown used to.
On the other hand, I have not once eaten dinner alone since I arrived here.
I am saving nearly four hundred dollars every month.
I had assumed that moving back would feel like a step backwards, and it does not.
